lines.t: Oh
Strength, make strength for his return
The earth trembles, the king is coming
Thus says the Lord to the peoples of the earth
In my right hand the power, the birth
In my left hand judgment and flame
I am he, the ancient of days
The great I am, the God of Abraham

Isaac and Jacob, whose name is Israel. None can shake him. I sent my only begotten. The word became flesh. Yahushua, Emmanuel, righteousness and breath. He came once in mercy. He comes again in power. Every knee will bow. Every nation will cower. The Holy One returns. The trumpet sounds. The Lord of hosts is heaven bound.
